subject: Novatel on-site demo + exec dinner — scheduling & runbook

To: Samir Desai <samir@novatel.com>, Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@novatel.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Novatel — on-site demo & exec dinner (proposed dates + runbook)

Hi Samir / Priya —

Thanks again for the productive demo last month. We’d love to come on-site to Novatel’s SF office for a 90-minute technical demo + hands-on session with your engineering team, followed by an executive dinner with your leadership and ours. To make planning easier I put together a short runbook attached (redwood-demo-runbook-v0.3.pdf) with proposed scope, roles, and logistics.

High-level options (all Pacific Time):
- Option A: Tue 2026-12-13, demo 2:00–3:30pm, exec dinner 7:00pm
- Option B: Wed 2026-12-14, demo 10:00–11:30am, exec dinner 7:00pm

Please let us know which option works best, and if procurement needs to be looped in (I cc’d Priya but feel free to add the right contact). Marcus (SE) and Hannah (Security) are on this thread for technical & compliance prep.

Attachments: redwood-demo-runbook-v0.3.pdf (scope, AV checklist, VPN steps)

If you prefer a quick 15-minute sync to confirm attendees, I can send a calendar invite.

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0119
From: Samir Desai <samir@novatel.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@novatel.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Novatel — on-site demo & exec dinner (proposed dates + runbook)

Thanks Tessa —

Appreciate the runbook. Option A (12/13) looks good for our execs from a calendar perspective; engineering prefers Option B (12/14) because we have a major deploy on 12/12 and the on-call rotation will be tight that week. Two asks from our side before we lock:

1) Hannah — can you confirm high-level SOC2/partitioning notes we can send to procurement for a POC? Our procurement team typically wants a one-page security summary.
2) Procurement — looping procurement@novatel.com (cc’d) — can you advise lead procurement contact for SOW/MSA redlines? We’ll need a purchase order timeline.

For dinner: 7pm downtown SF works. I’ll propose a shortlist of venues once date is confirmed.

Best,
Samir
Senior Engineering Manager | Novatel Systems

Hi all —

Thanks Samir. Marcus — can you confirm whether you can do the 12/14 morning deep-dive if Samir’s team prefers it? If not, we can try to make the 12/13 afternoon work but would need to bring a second SE.

Hannah — attached is a short SOC2 one-pager I created from our control matrix (soc2-highlevel-attestation.pdf). Would you be able to sign off or add notes we can hand to procurement?

Procurement team — welcome. For planning, typical logistics we need from your side: a primary PO contact, billing address, and any required NDAs/MSA redline instructions. We’re happy to accept a draft SOW and iterate; we can also provide a standard MSA if that speeds things up.

Provisional ask: if we land 12/14 we’d plan for 90 minutes with the SE deep-dive followed by a 45-minute Q&A with your platform/infra engineers. We’ll bring a small device for in-person inference testing (est time to test: 30 minutes).

If helpful I can spin up a 15-minute pre-call to run the table of contents for the agenda — shout if you want that.

Thanks —
Tessa

Hi team —

12/14 morning works for me (I’m on-call the 13th). I can cover the inference deep-dive and the hands-on run with the device. Two items I need from Novatel (please confirm before we travel):

- VPN/Network: please whitelist my public IP (I’ll send it once we lock the date) and provide a test VPN account 48 hours before the session so I can verify data-plane access.
- Access: who on your infra team will be the point person for port routing and permissions in case we need to test with a staging dataset?

If 12/14 is final I’ll update the runbook with the SE checklist and an AV needs table.

—Marcus

Thanks —

Procurement here: we reviewed the one-pager and the high-level SOC2 doc. A couple quick notes:

- Please send a redline-ready MSA or we will send our standard template. Our legal lead is out until 12/7, so we need to start redlines this week if we want to sign before EOY.
- Please upload the SOW draft to DocuSign PowerForm (or share a link); we prefer that route.

Also — due to a travel change for our VP (last-minute conference overlap), we need to move the exec dinner to the evening of 12/14 rather than 12/13. The team still prefers the deeper technical session on 12/14 morning if possible.

Procurement contact for PO: procurement@novatel.com (primary) — they will follow up with billing details and PO template.

Priya Reddy
